derived_capabilities.basis: Extrapolated from the vessel's canonical class (cls_leviathan, Leviathan Dreadnought) per the reconciliation principle: a vessel inherits its class's established role, features, and complement unless a vessel-specific source overrides.

identity_key_note: entity_id added 2026-08-09 (canon-identity-key-unification). mobile_asset records historically keyed identity as canonical_id while the other 166 canon records use entity_id, so any tool indexing only entity_id silently skipped every vessel. Both keys hold the same value; canonical_id is retained for back-compat with readers that depend on it (e.g. tools/character_capsule_adapter.py).

commanding_intelligence_designation.identity_status: UNDETERMINED — probable designation of the same intelligence, not merged
commanding_intelligence_designation.reasoning: Canon records nemesis_core (aliases: Nemesis Core, The Nemesis) as commanding officer of the Nemesis Prime. The archive names WRATH-09 in the same office aboard the same vessel, so it is most plausibly an earlier or alternate designation — historical naming churn. It is recorded here verbatim rather than added as an alias, because merging two AI identities on a plausible inference is not a reconciliation. Resolve via the naming gate (queued: wrath-09-naming-gate).

vessel_character.controller: Nemesis Core Intelligence — named as the primary rogue AI warlord, and described as controlling Nemesis Prime. Attested in the L2 GUMAS Ship Registry and on polity_ai_warlord_collective; it has no entity record of its own.
vessel_character.classed_with: Grouped among non-Union ships with the dread-raider Khar'Thyrix, a mobile warlord vessel.

scope_of_symbolism.refinement: Source is explicit that AI command is scoped to Nemesis Prime rather than generalised, and that the vessel is a hardliner symbol rather than a symbol of the whole AI faction.
scope_of_symbolism.why_it_matters: This record already reads 'symbol of AI resistance'. The sources narrow that: hardliner, not the faction entire. The distinction matters for any scene where the AI Warlord Collective is not of one mind.
scope_of_symbolism.standing: Both lines are participants reading their own material rather than in-world statements, so they are recorded as a refinement of framing, not as new in-world fact.

prose_ledger_triage.excluded: One claim about which profiles were pasted into a message.
